title: Self-Guided Centipede Desert ATV Rental
includes: 3-hours total (1 hour for check-in, 2 hours of training & riding)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
No skirts or dresses, no open-toed shoes
Must be 16+ years old to drive with a valid ID
Must be at least 18+ with a valid ID and credit or debit card to book
All minors must be accompanied by a parent
A signed waiver will be required in order to participate
All guests must speak and understand English
For the best experience we recommend booking the early morning tour times, temps are cooler and group sizes are smaller
This option is for single-passenger ATVs for ages 16+.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy an exciting day of off-roading in the famous Sonoran desert aboard your single-passenger ATV! To book multi-passenger vehicles for this tour, check out our "Self-Guided Centipede Desert UTV Rental." You will experience some of the best trails Arizona has to offer. Conveniently located just north of Phoenix at the base of the breathtaking Bradshaw Mountains. Our Unguided tours create an opportunity for you to enjoy the scenic Arizona landscape at your own pace. You will be with us for up to 3-hours total. Up to 1-hour check-in followed by up to 2 hours of training & riding.
